content.rendered:
Pebble -Portable Bluetooth Speaker| Eco-Friendly

Features

IPX5 Water- Resistant: Whether you’re by the pool, at the beach, or caught in the rain, the Pebble -Portable Bluetooth Speaker is built to withstand splashes and sprays, ensuring uninterrupted music enjoyment in any environment.
True Wireless Stereo (TWS): Seamlessly pair two Pebble speakers for an immersive stereo sound experience that fills the room and elevates your listening pleasure.
Powerful Bass: Don’t let its compact size fool you – the Pebble Speaker delivers deep, rich bass that enhances every beat and rhythm, bringing your music to life like never before.
Play Loud: With a 2W output RMS, the Pebble Speaker pumps out crisp, clear sound at impressive volumes, ensuring that your favorite tunes are heard loud and clear, wherever you go.
Type-C Charging: : Say goodbye to tangled cables and slow charging times. The Pebble -Portable Bluetooth Speaker features a convenient Type-C charge port, offering quick and hassle-free charging so you can get back to enjoying your music in no time.

Sustainable Materials

At the heart of eco-friendly portable speakers lies a commitment to sustainable materials. Manufacturers are increasingly opting for recycled or renewable resources in the construction of speaker components. From bamboo and cork to recycled plastics and aluminium, these materials offer a blend of durability, aesthetics, and eco-friendliness.
